title: FIG. 05 · The phase track
summary: The gantt you liked, rebuilt without the panel, caption strip and tabs: one line, "It starts with the audit.", then the four phases step down the page on a ruler that runs edge to edge, with the red audit first and your endless Calibrate line running off the right edge after the handover mark.
story: Having just shown the exit (the system stays when we leave), this section shows the entry: the only lit step is the small, fixed audit, the handover is marked on the track, and the line that never ends is labelled yours; it hands "the audit" straight to the next section, whose first words are "The audit is a gate".
motion: Entrance, standalone: the label fades in and "It starts with the audit." rises out of its mask. The ruler then calibrates across the whole width (its line draws edge to edge while the ticks arrive left to right, slightly off-pitch, and settle into place by about 1.9s). The lede rises beside the first phase.

Then the phases build in reading order, each label first and then its bar: Diagnose in red (from 1.0s), and as the red bar extends, the ten ruler intervals above it light one step brighter, so the scale visibly measures the audit. Architect follows (1.8s), then Install (2.5s). The Handover line draws down from the ruler (3.3s), its label appears, and the line beside it, "Install first, then an operating retainer — on a system you own.", rises in on your side of it. Calibrate's label rises and its bar runs out from the Handover line past the right edge of the page (about 4.0–4.9s). Then the Yours line draws. Everything has landed by about 5.2s.

Ambient, the page's only loop besides the hero film: a small dark square rides the Calibrate bar from the Handover line off the edge of the page, one lap every 9.6 seconds, steady and slow. It pauses whenever the section is off screen.

On the live page: the heading plays as the section arrives, but the track waits, held on its first frame, until it is about half in view, so the build happens where you can see it. It plays once. Nothing loops except the packet. Scrolling back does not replay it.
No controls. There are no tabs and no buttons to press, so nothing is stepped through for you.
Reduced motion: the finished drawing appears at once, with every bar built and no packet.
addressed: Your note: "we are repeating the layout to present each section very, very often". The panel, caption strip, tabs and two-line headline are gone. This section is now a single diagonal: one line of heading top-left, and the phases stepping down to the bottom-right.
It breaks the grid on purpose. The ruler runs the full width of the screen, and the last bar runs off the right edge, so the page itself shows that Calibrate never ends.
You liked the gantt idea, so it stays and becomes the centrepiece. It is easier to read now: each phase's name and outcome sit directly above its own bar.

Story: the heading says the first step outright ("It starts with the audit."). The audit is the one red bar, and the ten ruler intervals directly above it are the only lit part of the scale: ten working days, measured. Everything after it is marked Indicative.

The old contradiction ("we leave" next to a bar that never ends) is resolved. A Handover line is drawn on the track using the same word as the section above. Everything after it is labelled Yours: run by your operator, or with us on retainer.
Nothing is invented. Only the audit carries a duration; the ruler carries no other numbers, and the drawing is marked Indicative.

The empty top-right corner is filled with words already in the section: "Install first, then an operating retainer — on a system you own." moved from the bottom-left to just right of the Handover line, level with the first phase. It is the caption for what happens after handover, so it now sits on your side of that line, and the diagonal reads cleanly: heading top-left, phases stepping down to Calibrate and Yours at the bottom-right.
notes: NEEDS FOUNDER SIGN-OFF (D8): "10 working days" on the Diagnose bar, and the ruler's calibration to it, come from AuditSpec's [EDIT ME] timeline. D3: the section's red moved from Calibrate to Diagnose. D5: the statement "It starts with the audit." replaces "We install the system. / Then keep it sharp.". Copy sources: statement, phase names, the lede and the outputs from the approved round-2 method (the Diagnose output gains "— in a written readout", AuditSpec's written readout, the page's first "readout"; the Calibrate output gains "yours, run by your operator or with us on retainer", after FirmFit's "After handover an internal operator runs the system"); the closing line is FirmAbout's registry line, verbatim. Round-3 coherence pass: that closing line moved from under the track (cols 1–7, on Yours's line) to the zone right of the Handover datum, at the datum's 20px inset and on the lede's top line (top-aligned with row 1's label), set as 17px body copy (ac-body, --fg-2, max 32ch, breaking after the dash); it enters just after the datum's label (3.56s) instead of last. The lower-left is left as the diagonal's open side; Yours stays anchored to the datum's foot. Stage 1100px tall. Geometry: on the 1440 stage, col n starts at 64 + (n − 1) × 111.33. Bars are 10px: Diagnose cols 1–2 (red), Architect cols 3–5, Install cols 6–8, Calibrate from the Handover datum at the start of col 9 to past the edge (the section clips horizontally). Bar tops sit 130px apart, descending. Each row's label stands directly above its bar's start. The ruler runs the full stage width and is calibrated in working days: pitch = Diagnose bar ÷ 10 = 19.87px, so the red bar spans exactly ten intervals, with a major every fifth tick. The tick the datum would graze is dropped; the datum stands in for it. The ten intervals over the Diagnose bar (ticks from col 1 to the end of col 2) are one step brighter than the rest of the scale and light in step with the red bar: the only measured span on the ruler. The ruler is HTML, not SVG, and is hidden on mobile with visibility, not display:none. Reason: the capture tool briefly applies the ≤760px media query, and a display:none toggle there restarts the element's entrance, so it is captured blank. Other sections that hide an animated element with display:none on mobile will show the same blank in their shots. The title block (FIG. 05 · Phase track · Indicative) sits on the ruler's left end, its bottom edge on the ruler line. The Handover datum label uses the same kit caption as the handover section's own datum label. Everything set right of the datum (Handover, the Calibrate label, Yours) shares one 20px inset, so the three read as one column on your side of the line. Red: the label square and the Diagnose bar only. There is no 48×2 rule, because the red bar sits in the rule's place under the statement. No door and no note, per STORY; the ask comes two sections later. Mobile (≤760px): statement in two lines; the phases become a swipe track in their own container, snapping per phase; the datum and its Handover label form the left edge of card 4; Calibrate runs off the last card; no page-level horizontal scroll (checked at 390px with the stage forced to 390 wide, since the mockup stage is fixed at 1440). While the swipe track actually scrolls, it becomes a keyboard stop with a visible focus outline and the name "The four phases", so arrow keys can move it; on desktop it stays out of the tab order. Homepage-only behaviour: the track's animations are paused until the track is 45% in view, because the stitch starts each section at 22%, when only this heading is on screen. Annotation words in the drawing: 13. Body words at rest: about 90.
